import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Create a DataFrame from the given data
data = {
    "StichtagDat": ["2024-12-31", "2025-12-31", "2019-12-31", "2020-12-31", "2021-12-31"],
    "HID": [123408, 123408, 123481, 123481, 123481],
    "AlterV10Lang": ["30- bis 39-Jährige"] * 5,
    "SexLang": ["männlich"] * 5,
    "KreisLang": ["Kreis 7", "Kreis 7", "Kreis 10", "Kreis 10", "Kreis 10"],
    "AnzHunde": [1, 1, 1, 1, 1]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Set the visualization style
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a count plot for the number of dogs by year and sex
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.countplot(data=df, x="StichtagDat", hue="SexLang", palette="Set2")

# Customize the plot
plt.title('Number of Dogs Registered by Year and Sex')
plt.xlabel('Registration Date')
plt.ylabel('Number of Dogs')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.legend(title='Sex')

# Save the plot as output.png
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png')
plt.close()
